text: The Marusudar River, also known as the Maru Sudar River, is the largest tributary of the Chenab River. It originates from the Nunkun glacier in the Warwan Valley of the Kishtwar district and flows to join the Chenab River at Bhandarkoot, also in the Kishtwar district. The river is 133 kilometres (83 mi) long. As of 2021, the 1000MW Pakal Dul Dam and the 800MW Bursar Hydroelectric Project are under construction on this river.
